items.title: Frank Goudie Interview
items.q: I have a French name, and it's, it's my name, and I wanted it. You know. And they, they changed my first name, because my first name is Francis. Right.

ctx.x: I have a French name, and it's, it's my name, and I wanted it. You know. And they, they changed my first name, because my first name is Francis. Right. They called me Frank, so I took Frank. It's the same family with Francis.
The, uh, the European boys spelled it G-O-O-D-I-E, didn't they?
